получать.gloss: to receive, to get; to earn

meanings.en: to receive, to get; to earn
meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (root 'лучать'). Used in Russian as an imperfective verb expressing ongoing, habitual, or repeated action meaning 'to receive', forming an aspectual pair with 'получить'.

examples.trans: By copying facial expressions, you gain control.

meanings.note: Prefix 'пред-' ('before, fore-') indicates anticipation or prior position (root 'ставлять'). Used in Russian as an imperfective verb expressing ongoing, habitual, or repeated action meaning 'to imagine', forming an aspectual pair with 'представить'.

придумать.gloss: to think up, to come up with

meanings.en: to think up, to come up with
meanings.note: Prefix 'при-' indicates approaching, attachment, or slight degree of action (root 'думать'). Used in Russian as an perfective verb focusing on a single completed action or result meaning 'to think up', forming an aspectual pair with 'придумывать'.

examples.trans: Can you imagine what German thought up?
Fine, I will think of something right now.

издеваться.gloss: to mock, to kid, to mess with

meanings.en: to mock, to kid, to mess with
meanings.note: Prefix 'из-' ('out from within') marks extraction or exhaustion (root 'деваться'). Used in Russian as an imperfective verb expressing ongoing, habitual, or repeated action meaning 'to mock', forming an aspectual pair with 'поиздеваться'.
